The  performance  data will  include  publications,  citations,  research  grants,  patents, li censes,  and start-ups  founded  by members  of interdisciplinary  cluster  hires,  as well  as those  of a matched  sample  of faculty  hired  through  normal  departmental  mechanisms. Following  the end of the project, we will  contact  the Inter-University  Consortium for  Political  and Social  Research  (ICPSR) at the University  of Michigan  about  archiving  the  data on a permanent  basis.
